snippet.title: Office After Hours | Release Date Trailer (Steam PC)
snippet.description:
Office After Hours releasing on PC via Steam June 2nd 2025!  
💌WISHLIST now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207300/Office_After_Hours

Spot anomalies and uncover hidden clues to escape an office where overwork turns strange and experiments happen more often than coffee breaks.
At its core, Office After Hours explores the pressure of overwork and the relentless demand for perfect performance in modern corporate life. Get ready for 30 story based anomalies (40+ in total) and a mix of tension and humor - you'll either end up screaming or laughing!

• Developer: gameandcode
• Genre: Psychological Horror, Anomaly Hunting
• Platform: PC (Steam)

Music composed by Dirk J. Neefs
